$comment: What scripts/live-run.mjs runs for this leaf. Setup starts an Ollama server (daemonised: setup lines are foreground, and the CI job's teardown stops it) and pulls the model, so Commands 1 and 2 - the single call and the tool call, the leaf's first two rungs - run against the live endpoint with a tool-trained model. Commands 3-6 read agent.jsonl, a declared fixture trace in the shape the leaf's runner logs: run_complete and tool_call events, a repeated identical tool call, and one run stopped by the step cap, which is exactly what those commands exist to surface. KEY is a dummy: Ollama ignores it and the leaf's commands require one.

substitute.<task>: Reply with the single word ok.

setup.run: (ollama serve > ollama-server.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version && exit 0; sleep 1; done; exit 1
